title: TraceFlow mini-mosaic and CostSpark mockups for onboarding quickstart
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design and produce a compact set of onboarding visuals for the Observability Quickstart that highlight latency distribution, per-token cost sparkline, and a focused trace zoom card. Deliver PNG + SVG assets and an annotated screenshot pack for docs and release notes.
background: Product wants a smaller footprint onboarding panel for new users that surfaces three lightweight views: latency histogram, cost-per-token sparkline, and a focused trace zoom. Current assets are large and technical; this ticket aims to create approachable visuals for the quickstart flow and docs.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct mockups produced: Mini-Latency histogram card, CostSpark sparkline card, TraceZoom interactive snapshot
Annotated overlays for each mockup explaining interactions (hover, expand to timeline, link to full trace)
High-fi PNG and SVG exported at three scales: 1x, 2x, and thumbnail 120x80
Design tokens and color specs documented in the ticket and Figma file
Hand-off ready assets in Drive and links included in PRD and release notes
notes: Initial direction validated with PM — focus on clarity for non-technical users, avoid axis overload
Kept color palette aligned with console theme: teal for latency, amber for cost, indigo for traces
Consider small animation (micro-interactions) for hover state — engineering to evaluate feasibility
Decided to replace numeric percentiles with simple p50/p95 labels to reduce noise

2025-06-11: First wireframes completed; UX review noted need for stronger CTA to full trace (Liam).

2025-06-16: Design review — incorporate accessibility contrast adjustments and reduce legend size (Liam).
2025-06-18: Assets exported and packaged; annotation PDF drafted (Ava).
2025-06-20: Submitted for engineering handoff and in-review by PM (Liam).
feedback: PM: 'Love the smaller footprint — we need explicit link text to 'Open full trace' and a copy tweak on cost card.'

Accessibility reviewer: 'Increase color contrast on amber cost sparkline for AA compliance.'
next_steps: Address accessibility contrast adjustments and re-export assets (Ava).
Engineering to scope thumbnail payload and canvas lazy-loading (ENG-4021).
Docs to draft copy snippets and embed annotated screenshots in quickstart guide (PM-228).
Schedule handoff sync on 2025-06-22 for rollout coordination.
